reviews.comment: One of the most understanding and realistic principles ive had so far.
reviews.ratingTags: Get ready to read--Gives good feedback--Lots of homework

reviews.comment: Great prof! Class starts off easy and gets harder throughout the semester content wise. She does a great job teaching and uses guiding note taking during lectures. 2 tests and one final project with one weekly homework assignment. The tests are called "unexam exams" and are actually a very fun day. You will pass the exams.
Super easy class. Multiple tries on homework, non-proctored exams. A lot of homework assignments, but they're not super time-consuming. Gives some extra credit.
Lots of reading, BUT the homework was easy! The exams were IMPOSSIBLE to fail! She was so caring and loving!

I loved her!! I took the class online and although there is quite a bit of assignments, they are straightforward. You also have the opportunity to redo assignments if you would like. The class was easy to take along with my other coursework and would definitely recommend it to anyone!!

I was very nervous to take this class but taking it with Dr. Ramos was the best decision! She understands that this course is kind of difficult, but she made it easy. It is kind of assignment heavy, but nothing too crazy. As long as you do the work on time and follow her instructions, you'll pass. She is very sweet and caring! Take her if you can!

Just take her, she is probably one of the best professors i have taken at TAMU. She makes statistics easy and fun to learn. No exams just a final project which is very doable. If you did bad on any assigment she lets you resubmit for a better grade. Take her you wont regret it.
Recommend taking this class online. I saved a lot of time since it was online. Everything is pretty easy to grasp. The only "hard" assignment so far is the final project. It is very time-consuming.

Dr. Ramos has truly been one of the best professors I have taken at this university. We basically learn statics concepts, but she breaks them down to us. TAKE HER IN PERSON, the (couple) weekly assignments are easy to complete if you pay attention and review the slides. She is such a fun professor to have and she cares much about her students.

Dr. Ramos was an amazing professor and her lectures were well planned. There were about 1-2 daily grades a week, 2 tests total, and one final project. She lets you turn in all the hw grades again for credit back if turned in on time. I bought the textbook and used it for the class. I took this class in person, 435, and would not recommend online.

I love Prof. Ramos. She explains everything step by step and really wants her students to succeed. She lets you redo almost any assignments you want, so it's hard to do bad on daily grades. She is so kind and detailed in her explanations. Lots of review games/fun activities. She always reviews what we've already learned. Would highly recommend her!

I love Dr. Ramos. She cares so much about her students and is so sweet, understanding, and reasonable. She truly cares about each and every student one of her students success. She gives an extra week to redo assignments if you did not get a 100 and her assignments are not hard if you pay attention in class. She makes class fun and interesting!
Incredibly sweet and caring professor. She was the only reason I came to a zero credit class on a Friday afternoon. For sure recommend.

Prof. Ramos is an incredible professor! She is so kind and caring. I underestimated the final (Start early!), but the class is really easy and with the drawings & So You Think You Can Stat she makes it so fun! Redo everything she lets you, start early on the final project, and draw out everything & you will do great. Take her; you won't regret it!

It's a pass or fail class, but I assure you this teacher makes it as easy as possible to get through this 0 credit class that all freshman have to take anyway. She doesn't believe in teaching things that won't actually help new students, and she's more than understanding. She wants to know you personally and to see you succeed in all areas of life.

Dr. Ramos is a GREAT professor! She does lecture every class but for a statistics class she makes it pretty engaging. There are no tests, opportunities for extra credit, and you can re-do every assignment for a 100. You definitely have to doo work but it isn't very difficult. I would take Dr. Ramos again and agin!
reviews.ratingTags: Gives good feedback--Clear grading criteria--EXTRA CREDIT

reviews.comment: I loved this class and prof even though it was online! No tests at all and everything is graded off by how much effort you put into it (although most is competition) I used the book and it was helpful, 2 assignments a week/they're easy as long as you keep up with everything.
reviews.ratingTags: Gives good feedback--Participation matters--Clear grading criteria

reviews.comment: Prof. Ramos had weekly research and writing mini-projects, 4 bigger projects and one research paper for the final. Dr. Ramos is fast to answer any questions and is willing to help any student along the way. I enjoyed learning from Dr. Ramos.

The class material was extremely technical but Dr. Ramos is very accessible. Prof. was extremely fast in responding to my many questions, and her experienced background really gave me the confidence to fight through the difficult topics. Great class.

Dr. Ramos made statistics fun and related it to the real world. She genuinely cares about her students and tries to incorporate fun activities in class every day. She doesnt believe in tests and any assignment you turn in can be corrected for a 100. This class is an easy A! Attendance is not mandatory.

She is super engaging and makes learning statistics fun! She doesn't believe in tests or attendance, but going to her class is so much fun! I am someone who's terrible at math, but she made it easy to understand statistics. There are assignments and projects, but they're just reviews of what we've already been over. Overall, she was awesome!

Dr. Ramos is amazing! She is very understanding and easy to communicate with. As a graduate level class, you do read a lot and it may seem like "busy work" but if it applies to your job, you will appreciate what you learn in the class. Not only does she grade promptly, she actually gives constructive criticism. She will help you grow as a person!
reviews.ratingTags: Gives good feedback--Respected--Get ready to read

reviews.comment: The assignments are very practical-based. Great online class.

It's an online class with no tests. You're assigned a couple of things each week and they're all pretty easy. A couple of bigger projects that are spread out. Very easy grader. The only bad thing is I didn't understand a concept and she kept telling me to re-read the chapter even though I had and it didn't help. No office hours either.

Took this class online, there's no exams at all, it mostly consist on assignments due each week or projects due online. She gives you 3 opportunities to submit each assignment, if you are not happy with the grade she gives you on a assignment you can make corrections with the feedback she gives you and resubmit to receive full credit.
